12 Nov 2026: Madras HC First Bench reserved orders (no date) on CREDAI-Chennai and others' petitions against the NGT Southern Zone's Sept 2025 1-km construction-approval ban around Pallikaranai marsh; TN State Wetlands Authority proposes a 128.19 ha interim Zone of Influence (36 survey numbers) with site-by-site regulation; SC is hearing the wider wetlands question. Posted @idlynews 05:59 IST.

12 Nov 2026: government sources (PTI) say the Centre plans a special session to pass the Lok Sabha expansion amendment (543 to up to 850 seats, +50% per state keeping 1971 Census shares); 17 Apr attempt failed 298-230; @idlynews post 13 Nov 02:11 IST

13-14 Nov 2026: Karnataka CM Shivakumar, with PM Modi present at the CoSMOS inauguration in Mysuru, said 'no one can stop' Mekedatu and sought Central clearances; TN Congress chief Tagore called it deeply condemnable; Stalin asked CM Vijay for an all-party meeting (idly Instagram 14 Nov)

20 Nov 2026: SC (Vikram Nath, Aparesh Kumar Singh) dismissed TN's applications for ~11 TMC Cauvery backlog from Karnataka (1.3 TMC/day over 10 days sought); reasons not reported (idly Instagram 20 Nov)

20 Nov 2026: SC (Justices Aravind Kumar, Vipul M Pancholi) allowed a one-time Karthigai Deepam lamp by a small temple team at the disputed Thiruparankundram hill pillar on 24 Nov 2026; public barred; dargah/mosque access undisturbed; Madras HC findings on the pillar and land stayed; not recognition of custom; appeals listed 2nd week Jan 2027. The then DMK govt appealed the Dec 2025 single-judge order; TVK govt moved the SC on 11 June 2026.

21 Nov 2026: Union Health Ministry says over 1 crore 14-year-old girls got the free single-dose HPV vaccine since Feb 2026 (nearly 87% of ~1.2 crore target); Tamil Nadu at 76.12%, Kerala 77.02%; six states at 100%. @idlynews posted it (Df_n6aSHT0l).

idlynews posted (21 Nov 17:34 IST): SC limited notice to Centre (20 Nov 2026) on health risks of marriages between blood relatives; NFHS-5 2019-21: TN 28% of ever-married women 15-49 married to a blood relative (highest), Karnataka 27%, India 10.8%

Madras HC Division Bench (Justices CV Karthikeyan, S Raveekumar) holds a Hindu-Christian marriage can't be solemnised or registered under the Hindu Marriage Act; Sec 7A self-respect marriages need both partners Hindu; voids a Feb 2009 registration; judgment to be circulated to marriage registrars across TN (20-21 Nov 2026). idlynews posted 22 Nov.
